strategies.name: Scalar-vector split communication
strategies.desc: Separate the scalar projection term (v * s).mean() from the full vector all-reduce by using all_reduce on a size-1 tensor for the scalar and broadcasting it, then computing updates locally. Increases dispatch count to ~16 (8 vector + 8 scalar) but each scalar all-reduce is O(1) payload, potentially better for high-latency low-bandwidth regimes.

strategies.name: Pipelined interleaved computation-communication
strategies.desc: Issue next all_reduce asynchronously before completing local computation of current iteration's projection and update, overlapping communication of iteration i+1 with computation of iteration i. Same 8 dispatches but hides local arithmetic latency; requires careful dependency management to avoid incorrect overlaps.

strategies.name: Chunk-parallel reduce-scatter then all-gather
strategies.desc:
Decompose each all-reduce into reduce_scatter (partial sums on chunks) followed by all_gather, enabling per-chunk pipeline parallelism across the 8 iterations. Increases primitive count to 16 total dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but chunks enable bandwidth-optimal ring algorithms and potential inter-iteration parallelism on multi-device nodes.
